description: This file defines the `PageBreakRenderInfo` class, which provides rendering information related to page breaks within the MigraDoc document rendering system. It extends the `RenderInfo` base class and includes properties to access specific formatting info and document objects related to page breaks.

classes.name: PageBreakRenderInfo
classes.description: A sealed class that encapsulates rendering information for page breaks in the document, including format information and associated document object.

methods.name: PageBreakRenderInfo (constructor)
methods.description: Internal constructor initialization for the PageBreakRenderInfo object.

methods.name: FormatInfo (property)
methods.description: Overrides the base property to get or set the format information specific to page breaks.

methods.name: DocumentObject (property)
methods.description: Overrides the base property to get or set the document object associated with the page break.
